Name: JP's Leveling Multiplier (Add-on)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Leveling Multiplier[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because there's nothing more exciting than leveling up by hitting a simple rock, and what's more, with a “Level UP” sign above your head... How cool is that!!![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][size=4][b][color=#00ffff]This mod is an add-on for my main mod, [/color][color=#ffff00]“Hardew Valley”[/color][color=#00ffff], which significantly increases the game's difficulty. However, you can still use it without needing that mod. [/color][/b][/size][/i]


[size=3]This mode allows you to modify the XP multipliers for all skills so that you can level up faster or slower, changing the amount of XP obtained from each action you can perform in the valley. 
It also adds visual indicators above the player that show the amount of XP earned as well as when you level up. They don't add anything special, but they're there. [/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
